book.name: Fes Semyul
book.title: Fes Semyul Ola Stori Blanga Semyul En King Sol

content: Deibid bin snikap langa King Sol

Bambai na sambala men brom det deset kantri gulum Sif bin go langa King Sol deya langa det taun gulum Gibiya, en deibin dalim im Deibid bin blandimbat miselp langa det hil gulum Hekila deya wansaid langa det pleis gulum Jeshimon.
Wal streidawei King Sol bin gajim 3,000 gudwan Isreil solja, en deibin go langa det deset kantri blanga lukabat Deibid,
en wen deibin kamat langa det hil, deibin meigim kemp wansaid langa det roud. Wal Deibid bin stil deya langa det deset kantri.

Bat wen imbin irrim det wed weya King Sol bin kaman blanga lukabat im, imbin jandim sambala men snikinwei blanga faindat if King Sol bin deya, en wen deibin luk trubala imbin deya, deibin gobek en dalim Deibid,

en streidawei Deibid bin go en luk weya King Sol en det boswan solja blanga im bin jidan. Det boswan solja bin neim Ebna, en im dedi bin neim Nera. Wal Deibid bin luk King Sol en Ebna bin silip rait langa midul langa det kemp blanga olabat, en ola najalot solja bin silip raidaran langa dubala.

Wal dubala men neim Ahimalek en Ebishai bin deya garram Deibid. Ahimalek bin brom det traib gulum Hitait, en Ebishai bin abum braja neim Jowab, en dubala mami bin neim Seruwaiya. Wal Deibid bin askim dubala, “Hu garra kaman garram mi raidap langa det kemp blanga Sol?” En Abaishai bin tok, “Ai kaman garram yu.”

Wal midulnait na Deibid en Ebishai bin go langa det kemp blanga King Sol, en dubala bin luk King Sol en Ebna deya silip rait langa midul langa det kemp. Det spiya blanga King Sol bin jandap deya wansaid langa im hed, en ola solja blanga im bin silip raidaran langa dubala.
Wal Ebishai bin dalim Deibid, “Tudei na God bin hendimoba yu enami langa yu. Wal yu larram mi kilim im ded garram im ronwan spiya. Ai garra jis bugum im wantaim, binij. Im kaan gidap na.”
Wal Deibid bin tok, “Nomo! Yu kaan kilim im, dumaji YAWEI det trubala God bin pikimat im blanga jidan king blanga wi, en if enibodi garra kilim im, wal God garra panishim im.
Trubala ai dalim yu. YAWEI na garra kilim King Sol. Maitbi Sol garra dai wen im olmen o maitbi im garra dai wen im go en fait langa im enami olabat. Ai nomo sabi.

Bat ai sabi YAWEI kaan larram mi kilim det king weya imbin pikimat. Yunmi garra jis gajim det spiya en det jag garram woda deya wansaid langa im, en afta yunmi kambek.” Lagijat na Deibid bin tok langa Abaishai.
Wal Deibid bin gajim det spiya en det jag, en afta dubala bin gowei, en nobodi bin luk dubala deya. Ol detlot solja nomo bin sabi wanim bin hepin, dumaji YAWEI bin meigim olabat holot dedsilip.
Wal Deibid bin go en galimap langa najawan hil deya, en imbin jandap ontop langa det hil lilbit longwei brom det kemp blanga King Sol,

en imbin jingat langa ol detlot solja blanga King Sol na, en imbin jingat langa det boswan solja neim Ebna du, “Ebna! Yu gin irrim mi?” Wal Ebna bin tok, “Hu tharran deya jinginatbat en weikimapbat det king?”

Wal Deibid bin tok, “Ebna, yu det boswan solja, indit? Yu gulum miselp bigbala men brom ola najalot men, indit? Wal wotfo yu nomo lukaftumbat det king? Im na bos blanga yu, indit? Wal sambodi bin deya tudei langa yumob kemp blanga kilim det king,

en yu, Ebna, yu nomo bin maindimbat im brabliwei. Wal trubala ai dalim yu. Yumob bina dai blanga tharran, dumaji YAWEI bin meigim det men jidan king, en yumob nomo bin maindimbat im gudwei. Yu lukabat det spiya blanga det king na. En weya det woda jag blanga im? Dubala bin deya wansaid langa im hed. Wal weya dubala na?” Lagijat na Deibid bin tok langa Ebna.
Wal King Sol bin irrim Deibid jinginat langa Ebna, en imbin sabi det bois blanga im, en imbin tok, “Deibid, main lambarra, im yu tharran?” Wal Deibid bin tok, “Yuwai, bos. Mi na.
En wotfo yu oldei stil rijimbat mi? Wanim aibin dum langa yu? Wanim rong ting aibin dum?

Wal bos, yu irrim mi na. If YAWEI bin meigim yu rijimbat mi oldei, wal sambodi garra gibit im ofring blanga meigim im gudbinji wulijim im garra meigim yu libum dis nogudbala ting weya yu wandi kilim mi ded. Bat if God nomo bin meigim yu rijimbat mi oldei, wal im garra panishim det sambodi hubin meigim yu dum dis nogudbala ting, dumaji det sambodi bin andimwei mi brom main ronwan kantri weya ola pipul bulurrumbat YAWEI, en imbin meigim mi jidan iya langa dijan kantri weya ola pipul bulurrumbat ola najalot drimin.

Wal yu kaan larram mi dai iya langa dijan kantri longwei brom det Seikridwan Tent blanga YAWEI. Yu na det king blanga ola Isreil pipul. Wal wotfo yu weistimbat taim lukabatbat mi? Mi nomo enijing. Wotfo yu oldei lukabat mi jis laiga hanta weya im lukabatbat wail bard blanga kilim?” Lagijat na Deibid bin tok.

Wal King Sol bin tok, “Deibid, aibin dum nogudbala ting langa yu. Bat ai kaan dum enijing langa yu na, dumaji yu bina kilim mi tudei. Bat yu nomo bin duwit. Mi brabli granggibala, en aibin dum brabli nogudbala ting. Wal main lambarra, yu lafta kambek na.”
Wal Deibid bin tok, “Bos, iya na det spiya blanga yu. Wal yu dalim wanbala yangmen blanga kaman en gajim dis spiya.

En yu irrim mi na. YAWEI oldei dum gudbala ting langa detlot pipul hu oldei bulurrum im brabliwei en dum ola gudbala ting weya im wandim olabat blanga dum. Tudei na imbin hendimoba yu langa mi. Bat ai nomo bin dum enijing langa yu, dumaji im na bin pikimat yu blanga jidan king.
Aibin jinggabat yu, en aibin larramgo yu fri, en lagijat na YAWEI garra jinggabat mi en larramgo mi fri brom main trabul olabat du.” Lagijat na Deibid bin tok.

Wal King Sol bin dalim Deibid, “Wal main lambarra, God garra gudbala langa yu, en im garra albumbat yu blanga ebrijing weya yu wandi dumbat.” Lagijat na King Sol bin tok. Afta na Deibid bin gowei brom deya, en King Sol en im solja olabat bin gobek langa olabat ron kemp.
